observations.evidence: Verified official opencode-linux-x64 1.19.0 payload exits with signal 6 for --version and --help.

observations.name: Pi hierarchy
observations.evidence: The dependency installation was interrupted when network approval was cancelled. No Pi CLI was launched; no nested-loading conclusion is inferred.

observations.name: Claude Code startup
observations.evidence: Verified official claude-code-linux-x64 2.1.296 payload aborts on --version and --help; Bun reports panic(main thread): abort() called.

observations.name: imports/rules/skills/MCP/deny/env expansion
observations.evidence: Startup is blocked, so every requested configuration behavior remains unverified. Official documentation is corroboration only.

observations.name: hierarchy/skills/MCP/sandbox/env expansion
observations.evidence: Both no-daemon, read-only headless probes fail while loading config without /proc/self/exe. The local Responses fixture receives zero requests; no configuration behavior is inferred.

observations.name: dedicated Unix socket
observations.evidence: tmux -S <M0_TMP>/tmux.sock new-session exits 1: error connecting to <M0_TMP>/tmux.sock (Operation not permitted). Independent socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM) also raises errno 1.

observations.name: paste/Enter/idle/working/approval screens
observations.evidence: No tmux pane can be created. No screen fixtures or UI state patterns are fabricated.

observations.name: order/scope/shadow/disposal
observations.evidence: S-5 real SystemPrompt orders, isolates, shadows, and disposes scoped sections.

observations.name: async assembly replacement
observations.evidence: S-5 real asynchronous assembly returns replacement sections and contexts in one scope. Awaited preparation and scope isolation verified.

observations.name: restrict/guard/scope boundary
observations.evidence: S-5 real tool restrictions remove visibility and execution; guards cannot be overridden. Calling outside the scope still succeeds, confirming that scope is not a security boundary.

observations.name: profile/bundle/dump-config/logged snapshots/AGENTS disablement
observations.evidence: The complete DSH CLI dependency installation was interrupted by network approval cancellation. Direct registry tests do not prove profile loading or changed-only logged snapshots.

observations.name: real provider registration and continuation rejection
observations.evidence: S-6 real product providers register but reject continuable children before any launch: UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY; prepareContinuable absent; agentOptions:false; disposal unregisters both providers.

observations.name: live child cwd/instruction loading/follow-up/interrupt/settled/usage
observations.evidence: No native child was launched. Package source derives cwd from parent Session and excludes product usage from the parent result. Unsupported continuation is sufficient to reject adoption, independently of live authentication.
